source_review: Full original and native French/English label crop visually reviewed.
output_review: All six full images visually reviewed; native label crops inspected. Every result has credible article-size UGC finish and recognizable core bottle/brand/pattern; exact-copy deviations are explicitly labeled.
scope: One shared brief, one output per model, no reruns; editorial winner for this sample, no statistical claim.

results.verdict: Convincing warm UGC finish and readable main copy. Loses the accent in protège and replaces the small lower label lines with invented text.
Natural window light and recognizable packaging. Changes Apaise to Apaisa and invents the small lower label copy.
Readable main French and English copy, convincing hand-held scene. Invents the small lower label lines and changes the spray-head presentation.
Winner for label fidelity. Keeps Apaise et protège, Sans conservateur / Preservative-free, the volume and Made in France legible, with a strong UGC finish.
Bright, polished UGC image and readable main French copy. Omits Sans conservateur / Preservative-free from the lower label.
Soft, believable daylight and readable main copy. The small lower label and origin text become garbled.
